The full story of how a Corsican officer rewrote the map of Europe: [EPISODE 2 URL]

b_myth.title: Was Napoleon really short? #Shorts
alternatives: Why we think Napoleon was tiny #Shorts
b_myth.tags: Napoleon height, was Napoleon short, Napoleon myths, Little Boney, Gillray, history myths, history shorts, Wars That Shaped the World, Napoleon Bonaparte
b_myth.pinned_comment: Which history myth should we bust next? Full story: [EPISODE 2 URL]
b_myth.description:
Napoleon was recorded as five feet two in French units, which is about five foot six or seven in English ones, close to average for his time. The 'tiny Napoleon' came from British caricature.

The full story: [EPISODE 2 URL]
